summary: The StudentPrerequisites file governs the business logic, validation, update operations, and data model for tracking and updating student prerequisite health, safety, and confidentiality requirements within the HSPnet system. It implements detailed workflows for updating immunization, mask fit tests, health requirements, infection control solutions, confidentiality, ID card issuance, and related safety documents for students. The file enforces strict date, value, and field validations.
purpose: To provide business rules, workflow steps, update logic, validations, field definitions, and system behaviors for managing and tracking the complete set of student prerequisites regarding health, safety, and confidentiality before placement.

workflows.name: Update Student Prerequisite
steps: Receive request to update StudentPrerequisite (various triggers)
Validate input fields, including dates, codes, and required data
If requirements are met, update respective fields in StudentPrerequisite (immunizations, mask fit, health, confidentiality, ID card)
Enforce business rule: do not update if invalid (date out of range, missing mandatory field, etc.)
Commit update to database through defined stored procedures

workflows.name: Validate Student Prerequisite
steps: Check for required mask fit test if mask size is specified
Check that fit test dates are not more than 5 years in future
Check expiry date if years specified
Check that expiry date is after completed date
Check immunization/medical dates are not more than 5 years in the past
Check year values for disease confirmation fall within MIN_YEAR and MaxYear
Check that title dates do not exceed allowed range
Add error messages and prevent update if validations fail

business_rules: Dates for health, immunization, mask fit, must not be more than 5 years in past or future
Expiry date is required if expiry years are specified
Mask fit test date required if mask size is specified (and not 'Unknown')
Immunization and health requirements must be met before placement
Year values for disease confirmation must be between MIN_YEAR (1921) and current year
Consent program must be specified for confidentiality form updates
Confidentiality form received date must be valid and not empty
validations: Date fields are checked for valid format
Expiry date must be after completed date
Field presence and value ranges for codes, dates, and booleans
Immunization, infection, and safety records must be validated for business rules and field dependencies
Error messages are generated and update prevented if validation fails
calculations: TetanusExpiryDate calculated as 10 years after TetanusAdminDate if not explicitly given
conditions: If mask size specified and not 'Unknown', mask fit test date must be given
If expiry years specified, expiry date is mandatory
If OccHealthReqMetStatusCodeID is 0, ImmunReqMetDate is set to NullDate
If ConsentProgramID is NullInt, update is invalid
system_behavior: Stored procedures invoked for each update
Error messages collected and operation prevented if validation fails
Handles updates for safety, immunization, mask, confidentiality, and ID card
dependencies: Relies on Codes for lookup values (e.g., mask size, status codes)
Depends on DateFormatter, Database, and Session objects
exceptions: Invalid or missing required fields (date, code, etc.) prevents update
Dates exceeding allowed ranges add error messages
Consent program missing or invalid blocks confidentiality updates
content_gaps: No UI workflow steps (screens/forms) explicitly described
Business rules for error messages are referenced but actual text may be stored elsewhere
Mapping of actor permissions and triggers for workflow initiation is not fully specified
Full set of code descriptions for dropdown fields are referenced but not enumerated in the content
